caption:
5 prompts to write better.

1. Make this clearer. Keep my words where possible.
2. Cut this to half the length without losing points.
3. Make this polite but firm, for a professor.
4. What will the reader feel? Fix anything rude.
5. List grammar mistakes. Explain each in one line.

Keep your own voice. Send this to a friend writing an SOP.
